description: This file is part of the PyTorch code generation system, specifically for static runtime operator code generation. It defines functions and classes for generating operator dispatch code, test cases, and handling various operator properties and constraints within the static runtime code generation framework.

classes.name: GenOpDispatcher
classes.description: Class responsible for generating operator dispatch code for different operator groups and views, including out variants and view operators.

classes.name: GenOpTestCase
classes.description: Class responsible for generating test cases for static runtime operators, including out variants and view operators.

methods.name: has_alias
methods.description: Checks if any argument in the provided sequence has an alias set.

methods.name: is_supported
methods.description: Determines if a given native function group or view group is supported for static runtime code generation based on various constraints and properties.

methods.name: ivalue_type_conversion_method
methods.description: Returns the method call expression to convert a c10::ivalue to the expected argument type.

methods.name: should_use_int_tensor
methods.description: Checks if the operator name is in the set of operators that should use int tensors.

methods.name: should_use_complex_tensor
methods.description: Checks if the operator name is in the set of operators that should use complex tensors.

methods.name: test_tensor_dim
methods.description: Returns the tensor dimension for a given operator name based on predefined sets.

methods.name: test_tensor_shape
methods.description: Returns a tensor shape string for a given operator name based on predefined JSON configuration.

methods.name: test_value_expression
methods.description: Generates a string expression representing a test value for a given argument type, index, and operator name.

methods.name: generate_test_value_definitions
methods.description: Generates code defining test values for all arguments of a function schema.

methods.name: generate_test_value_names
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated string of test value variable names for a function schema.

methods.name: generate_test_ir_arguments
methods.description: Generates a list of tuples containing argument variable names and their types for IR test generation.

methods.name: generate_arg_extraction
methods.description: Generates code to extract arguments from a ProcessedNode for testing.

methods.name: get_kernel_name
methods.description: Retrieves the kernel name for a given native function group based on the backend index.

methods.name: get_out_kernel_name
methods.description: Retrieves the kernel name for an out variant of a native function group.

methods.name: generate_non_out_variant_call
methods.description: Generates code to call the non-out variant of a native function.

methods.name: generate_call_to_view_ops
methods.description: Generates code to call a view operator.

methods.name: generate_out_variant_call
methods.description: Generates code to call the out variant of a native function.

methods.name: op_name_from_group
methods.description: Extracts the base operator name from a NativeFunctionsGroup.

methods.name: GenOpDispatcher.out_variant
methods.description: Generates operator registration code for out variants of a list of native function groups.

methods.name: GenOpDispatcher.view
methods.description: Generates operator registration code for view groups.

methods.name: GenOpDispatcher.out_variant_op_generator
methods.description: Generates code for an out variant operator.

methods.name: GenOpDispatcher.view_op_generator
methods.description: Generates code for a view operator.

methods.name: GenOpTestCase.out_variant
methods.description: Generates test cases for out variants of native function groups.

methods.name: GenOpTestCase.view
methods.description: Generates test cases for view operators.

methods.name: GenOpTestCase.out_variant_op_test_case_generator
methods.description: Generates a specific test case for an out variant operator.

methods.name: GenOpTestCase.view_op_test_case_generator
methods.description: Generates a specific test case for a view operator.
